summary: Describes known operational problems when DHCPv6 relays are used with prefix delegation, which can break delegation and cause routing failures. It sets out functional requirements for relays to avoid these problems.

eli5.summary: When a middleman passes a message between your home router and the ISP, it must do so carefully, or you will not get the addresses you need.
